sourceMethod: Official public HTML parsed through web tool. This environment shell could not resolve public hosts; no raw HTML or direct fetch/API connectivity verified. Web tool results are cached crawls ranging today to several weeks, distinct from fetchedAt. All image URLs copied from actual page links, never guessed.
displayRules: Simulator only; no real orders, money transfers, stock reservation, merchant integration or affiliation implied.
Show source merchant and source link, with Cached on timestamp.
Food prices are merchant Galway collection-menu FROM prices, not Uber Eats delivery quotes.
Keep demoPrice visually labelled Demo estimate and never substitute it silently for sourcePrice.
No verified live stock or size inventories. null means unknown.
Image status is explicit: discovered links are sourced, but many could not be opened through web cache and require actual runtime image load testing.
Zara and StockX product imagery is third-party source imagery; public accessibility is not a reuse licence.

practicalSources.recommendation: Use actual Supermac's menu, source merchant prominently. HTML includes complete food names, from-EUR prices, category headings and exact api.supermacs.ie/uploads PNG links. No API auth needed for this public snapshot.

practicalSources.storefront: Uber Eats optional real marketplace source
practicalSources.recommendation: Official Uber Eats menu confirms actual merchant and EUR delivery-menu item prices. Different location and prices from Galway. Do not mix its prices with official Galway records.

Public product HTML exposes image links, style, colorway, all-size lowest ask, and German EUR snapshots. Several other German pages exceeded fetch-tool content limit; avoid depending on runtime unauthenticated scraping.

Irish category plus product HTML gives genuine product names, references, colours, EUR prices and exact static.zara.net image links. Use cache; actual variant sizes need a later authorised browser/product fetch.

notRecommended.reason: Product facts official, no actual EUR price; retrieved image links resolved to Bord Bia badge rather than food photo. Supermac's is more complete for current research.
